title: Exact sequences of rt-categories
summary: Our aim is to consider what the exact sequence for rt-categories is. For this, we introduce the notion of exact sequence of rt-categories, modeled on exact sequences of finite tensor categories. Our central result explores the relationship of exactness at different levels. Specifically, let $H_1\xrightarrow{f}H_2\xrightarrow{g}H_3$ be a sequence of finite-dimensional Hopf algebras.
